ValidationRule.description: Epoch Seconds must agree with Kickoff At within an hour, share its calendar year, and not sit more than 10 years ahead.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Kickoff_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Epoch_Seconds__c)), OR( ABS(UNIXTIMESTAMP(Kickoff_At__c) - Epoch_Seconds__c) > 3600, YEAR(DATEVALUE(FROMUNIXTIME(Epoch_Seconds__c))) <> YEAR(DATEVALUE(Kickoff_At__c)), FROMUNIXTIME(Epoch_Seconds__c) > NOW() + 3650 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Epoch Seconds does not match the Kickoff At timestamp.
